consumers: generated privileged-merge callers across the active repository fleet
ACTIONS_VARIABLES_TOKEN.reason: New and existing generated privileged callers require the token; visibility can narrow only after caller inventory becomes an exact selected-repository set.

consumers: Verjson/.github gate-rearm and AI review workflows
AI_REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Broad copy retained as migration state while the environment-only custody contract lands; the key is consumed only by canonical workflows in the policy repository and this scope may not widen.

consumers: reusable AI review callers using secrets: inherit
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.reason: Required and reusable workflows resolve organization secrets in each caller repository's context; all preserves the fleet gate without silently supplying an empty key.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.reason: The DeepSeek cascade runs only in the canonical policy repository, so no caller repository needs direct credential access.

DEPENDENCY_SUPERSESSION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Consumed only by dependency-supersession-reconcile in this repository, which currently binds no environment. Same provisioning prerequisite and withdrawal order as the Renovate compatibility key (#1285, ADR 0179).

consumers: merge-app environment secret of each adopting repository
MERGE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Same exposure and remedy as the review key: privileged merge and promotion retry read the merge-app environment secret, and the broad copy is withdrawn once the generated callers across the fleet are regenerated at the ADR 0171 contract revision (#1285).

NODE_AUTH_TOKEN.reason: Package consumers span the fleet and private or unindexed repositories cannot be proven absent by code search.

consumers: generated privileged-merge and promotion-retry callers across the active repository fleet
MERGE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Broad copy retained as migration state until every generated privileged-merge caller resolves the merge App key from its main-only environment. Fleet-wide caller adoption requires all visibility until that migration completes; this scope may not widen.

OPENAI_API_KEY.reason: The selected provider credential is intentionally limited to the canonical policy repository.

consumers: Verjson/.github fleet-watchdog, runner-admission, privileged-merge conformance, organization secret-scope, and ruleset-conformance audits
other separately audited trusted scheduled workflows
ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN.reason: Terminal merge and canonical release no longer consume this PAT, but organization runner, ruleset, secret-scope, conformance, watchdog, and umbrella operations still require capabilities outside the dedicated merge App. Do not delete or narrow it until those consumers migrate independently.

consumers: release-app environment secret of each adopting repository
RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Release snapshot, container promotion, Renovate attribution and the release canary read the release-app environment secret. The broad copy was never manifested and remains readable from any non-fork ref of every granted repository (#1285).

RENOVATE_COMPATIBILITY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.reason: Consumed only by capability-floor-observe, dependency-supersession-observe, dependency-supersession-reconcile, renovate-compatibility-reconcile and renovate-grouping-plan in this repository, all of which currently bind no environment at all. Provision renovate-compatibility-app with an exact main-only deployment-branch policy, move the key into it, then withdraw this copy (#1285, ADR 0179).

REWORK_RECONCILE_TOKEN.reason: Only the canonical repository's rework reconciliation needs cross-repository read beyond GITHUB_TOKEN; it falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN elsewhere, so no other repository requires the grant.

consumers: Node and UI CI callers with private git dependencies
SUBMODULES_TOKEN.reason: Consumer discovery is not complete across private repositories and inherited reusable-workflow calls, so selected visibility is not yet a safe claim.
